notes.title: Quick Look: WIP Customizable Slime Shader
notes.content:
Just a quick look at the new WIP Customizable Slime Shader that we're currently working on for the game.  Players will be able to choose the colour of their slime to their liking, affecting not only the look of the slime, but also affecting the look of any slime related abilities as well

[previewyoutube=6NMgZDp2o0U;full][/previewyoutube]
